description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Eight], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Ice abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1] after using Ice abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Ice 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Ice 166% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Ice Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user if Level 3+ EnIce, grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Ice attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Ice 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Ice ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Ice 166% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [166% ATB 1] after using an Ice ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 166% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.66

description.name: Ice Quick Cast (Tactical)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Ice while in Tactical Awoken Mode

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
